categories.name: Office Casuals
categories.description: Solid cotton shirts cut for a working day that runs long.
categories.bannerLine: Smart enough for the boardroom, soft enough for the drive home.
categories.imageAlt: Man in a white formal shirt and black trousers
categories.blurb: Our office shirts are built around breathable cottons in colours that work with grey, beige and charcoal trousers. They hold a crease through a nine-hour day and still look right at a family dinner.

categories.name: Kurta Pajama
categories.description: Occasion sets with embroidery, print and jacquard. Made to be worn often.
categories.bannerLine: For the wedding season, the festivals and every quiet evening in between.
categories.imageAlt: Man in a mint green kurta leaning on a tree branch
categories.blurb: Our kurta pajamas are finished by hand in our Erise workshop. Every set is pressed, checked and ready to wear, so nothing arrives needing work.

products.name: Royal Blue Embroidered Kurta Set
products.fabricNote: A cotton-silk blend with a soft sheen, with multicolour thread and mirror embroidery.
products.description: A royal blue kurta with a band collar, an embroidered placket and a deep embroidered hem, worn with a white pajama. Made for weddings and festive evenings.
details: Scattered motif buttis across the body
products.care: Dry clean recommended. If hand washing, use cold water and turn inside out to protect the embroidery.

Royal blue embroidered kurta, seated in a palace courtyard
Royal blue kurta from the back, plain body with embroidered collar

products.name: Midnight Navy Embroidered Kurta Set
products.fabricNote: A soft cotton blend with tonal gold thread embroidery on the yoke.
products.description: A midnight navy kurta with gold embroidery down the yoke and small buttis across the body, worn with a matching navy pajama. Quiet enough for a dinner, sharp enough for a sangeet.
details: Gold thread embroidery on the yoke
products.care: Hand wash separately in cold water. Dry in shade and iron on the reverse.

products.name: Magenta Printed Kurta Set
products.fabricNote: Breathable printed cotton, comfortable through a long day of functions.
products.description: A magenta kurta with an all-over white wave print, worn with a white pajama. Bright, easy and made for haldi, mehendi and festival days.
products.care: Hand wash separately in cold water for the first few washes. Dry in shade.

products.name: Lemon Yellow Jacquard Kurta Set
products.fabricNote: A woven jacquard silk blend with a tonal pattern that catches the light.
products.description: A lemon yellow jacquard kurta with a band collar, worn with an off-white pajama. A classic for haldi and daytime ceremonies.

products.name: Plum Cotton Formal Shirt
products.fabricNote: Smooth cotton with a light stretch, so it moves with you through the day.
products.description: A deep plum formal shirt with a spread collar, worn here with beige trousers. A colour that lifts a plain office wardrobe without shouting.
products.care: Machine wash cold with similar colours. Iron on medium.

products.name: Stone Grey Cotton Shirt
products.fabricNote: Fine cotton with a soft hand, cool enough for an Ahmedabad summer.
products.description: A light stone grey shirt with a spread collar, worn with charcoal trousers. The easiest shirt in the wardrobe, and the one that goes with everything.
products.care: Machine wash cold. Iron on medium.

products.name: Olive Green Cotton Shirt
products.fabricNote: Medium-weight cotton that keeps its shape, washed for a softer feel.
products.description: A deep olive shirt worn with light grey trousers. Smart enough for a Friday at the office and relaxed enough for the weekend.
details: Full sleeves, roll them or button them
products.care: Machine wash cold with dark colours. Iron on medium.
